subject: Leadership: Safety-net plan for high-risk survey signals and manager actions
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership: Safety-net plan for high-risk survey signals and manager actions

Team —

Quick summary from the engagement pulse I ran with People Ops this week: the dataset flags a concentrated set of retention-risk signals clustered in two product squads and one infra team. I’ve attached an initial risk matrix and a manager-action checklist. Top-line observations:

- 7 employees showing high combined risk (sentiment + intent to leave + 1:1 churn indicators).
- Several upcoming org changes (role consolidations) overlap with the same squads.
- Managers have logged fewer 1:1s in the last six weeks; three of the seven high-risk folks report low manager touch.

As leadership, we need two things by end-of-day Monday:
1) Managers assigned to the flagged list to complete 30–45 minute check-ins using the checklist (attachment 2). Please confirm completion in the Drive sheet.
2) Hold any structural role moves that would touch these teams until we get through manager interventions and a short-term stabilization window (2–4 weeks).

Sensitive note: a subset of cases contains confidential health/family reasons and should be handled offline with People Ops. Laura — can you confirm protocol and who from People Ops should be the single escalation point?

I’ve shared the risk matrix and manager checklist in the Drive and included a HubSpot ticket so CS/Customer-facing risk can be correlated if needed.

Attachments: engagement_risk_matrix.xlsx (summary), manager_action_checklist.pdf

Thanks — I’ll collate manager confirmations Monday and push an anonymized summary to the exec deck.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership: Safety-net plan for high-risk survey signals and manager actions

Thanks Rachel — good catch and appreciate the checklist. A couple quick clarifying Qs:

- On the anonymized matrix, two entries (IDs 4 and 6) look like they might belong to the same manager but are listed under different squads. Can you confirm whether that’s a cross-reporting situation?
- For the sensitive cases: are we okay to include brief, non-medical notes in manager logs (e.g., "family leave pending") or should managers only record that People Ops has been notified?

I’ll start scheduling the 30–45 check-ins today and ping people for calendar slots. I can take ownership of the infra team check-ins but will need updated talking points for the ones that have high customer impact.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Shah <anita.shah@benchhr.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership: Safety-net plan for high-risk survey signals and manager actions

Rachel/Monica —

Thanks for the summary. People Ops will be the escalation point for any confidential cases; please route those directly to me (laura_bennett@redwood.com) and I’ll triage with Anita (external consultant) if we need short-term accommodations or EAP support.

Guidance for manager notes: please do not include medical details or sensitive personal data in free-text fields. Managers may record a neutral status note and the fact that People Ops was contacted (e.g., "PO notified; accommodation requested"). We will maintain a separate secure log for PII and medical accommodations.

On the matrix items you flagged: ID 4 and ID 6 are cross-team reporting (temporary dotted-line due to an ongoing project). I’ll update the matrix by EOD so the assignments are clear.

Two additional asks from People Ops:
- If we move any role changes off the table for 2–4 weeks, please send the affected role IDs to me so we can communicate to recruitment and hiring managers to pause offers/renegotiations where necessary.
- People Ops can stand up a small "safety net" budget (up to three targeted retention credits) available subject to leadership sign-off; we’ll need names and proposed retention ask amounts for approval.

I’ll coordinate offline on the sensitive items.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership: Safety-net plan for high-risk survey signals and manager actions

Agree with the pause and the manager-first approach. A couple of operational notes:

- Let’s prioritize L4 managers for the first wave of check-ins; they have the highest leverage. Monica — can you confirm which two L4s cover those squads?
- I suggest we prepare two targeted retention offers (one for product, one for infra) and keep them in our back pocket. Laura — please outline the approval window so we can move quickly if a high-risk employee signals intent to accept an external offer.
- For transparency, I’d like a one-page anonymized summary for execs by Wednesday morning. Rachel — can you own that?

Cc’ing Vivek so he’s aware; if PSV numbers spike we may need short-term capacity pauses for hiring.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Anita Shah <anita.shah@benchhr.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership: Safety-net plan for high-risk survey signals and manager actions — plan + deadlines

Thanks all — finalizing cadence and next steps below.

Action items (owners / deadlines):
- Managers complete 30–45 check-ins and mark completion in Drive: Monica to own infra team; others to complete by 2026-07-14 EOD.
- Laura to update matrix (cross-reporting clarified) and confirm People Ops escalation protocol by 2026-07-13 noon.
- Leadership to sign off on up to three targeted retention credits (names/amounts via confidential email to Laura) by 2026-07-14 noon.
- Rachel to produce anonymized executive one-pager by 2026-07-15 09:00 and upload to exec Drive.

I’ve updated the Drive folder and added the HubSpot ticket to correlate customer impact. Please do not forward sensitive notes outside this thread.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-risk-playbook
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/HP-4829

I’ll follow up Wednesday with the exec summary and a short proposed comms note for hiring/recruitment.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
